q1_issues.issue: The whenever/when machinery's per-occurrence tie is missing — nothing (no During, no Time) links the derived fly event to the cold night $x, so the consequent states that nightmoths rarely fly without restricting the flying to the trigger occasion.

q2_gaps: bare "when P, Q" whose trigger clause P is COPULAR over a time-denoting entity ("when a night is cold") — the whenever machinery ties the response to its trigger with During, which presumes an eventive trigger, and a copular premise mints no eventuality to nest in (a premise may not carry a Skolem state term)
notes: Compound handling is right — the solid spelling gets its head genus (moth) and the noun modifier night is correctly suppressed. "rarely" → rule strength 0.1 at confidence 0.9 plus the QuantifierPhrase companion follows the frequency dial exactly.
